import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def t(req, ev, pol, expected):
    frozen=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol))
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==expected,(got,expected)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==frozen
    assert set(got)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}

base={'required_conditions':['recipe','material'],'require_verified':False}
r={'claim':'x','conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M'}}
t(r,[{'source':'v','claim':'x','value':7,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M'}}],base,{'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['v'],'unknowns':[]})
